unlock.title: Unlock your vault
unlock.explain: Your vault key is never kept after the page reloads — that's deliberate. Enter your password to unlock it on this device.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.intro: The people you're leaving something for. Each person only ever receives what is addressed to them.
recipients.emptyBody: Add the first person you want to leave something for. Once they're added, you can write to them.
recipients.integrityError: This entry could not be decrypted and may have been altered. Don't rely on it — edit it to re-enter the details.
recipients.loadError: Your recipients could not be loaded. Please try again.

form.name: Name
form.relationshipHint: For example: daughter, brother, close friend.
form.phoneHint: International format, starting with the country code — for example +962 79 123 4567.
form.methodsHint: Choose at least one. Email needs an email address; SMS needs a phone number.
form.encryptedNote: Name and relationship are encrypted on this device before saving. Email and phone are stored readable, because they're needed to reach this person.

errors.relationshipRequired: Enter how you know this person.
errors.phone: Enter the number in international format, starting with + and the country code.
errors.methodRequired: Choose at least one delivery method.
errors.emailForMethod: Add an email address to deliver by email.
errors.phoneForSms: Add a phone number to deliver by SMS.
errors.contactRequired: Add an email address or phone number so this person can be reached.

delete.title: Delete this recipient?
delete.body: {{name}} will be removed from your legacy, and nothing will be delivered to them.

emergency.title: Emergency contact
emergency.explain: If you stop checking in, this person is asked to confirm you're alive before anything is delivered. They never see what's in your vault.
emergency.none: No emergency contact yet. Without one, missed check-ins lead straight to delivery once the grace period ends.
emergency.fromRecipient: Is this one of your recipients?
emergency.emailHint: Their confirmation link will be sent here.
emergency.removeBody: Without an emergency contact, missed check-ins lead straight to delivery once the grace period ends.
emergency.loadError: Your emergency contact could not be loaded. Please try again.

linkDialog.title: Add a link
linkDialog.hint: A full address such as https://example.com — or an email address.
linkDialog.invalid: Enter a full web address starting with https:// or http://, or an email address.

items.title: Messages for {{name}}
items.intro: Everything here is addressed to this person only. No one else you add will ever receive it.
items.emptyBody: Write the first message for {{name}}. You can come back and change it whenever you like.
items.loadError: These messages could not be loaded. Please try again.
items.notFound: This recipient or message no longer exists.
items.limitReached: This is the most messages one person can have. Delete one to write another.
items.integrityError: This message could not be decrypted and may have been altered. It can't be opened or delivered as it is. If you didn't expect this, delete it and write it again.
items.reorderError: The order could not be saved. Please try again.
items.fieldTitleHint: Shown above the message when it is delivered.
items.fieldBodyHint: Write in any language. Each paragraph follows the direction of its own text.
items.encryptedNote: The title and message are encrypted on this device before they are saved. Every time you save, they are encrypted again with a new key.
items.unsaved: Your changes to this message have not been saved.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this message?
deleteDialog.body: “{{title}}” will be removed from what {{name}} receives.
deleteDialog.bodyUnreadable: This unreadable message will be removed from what {{name}} receives.

errors.tooLarge: This message is too long to save. Shorten it and try again.
